title: Wh- questions in the past simple

objective.en: Ask Wh- questions about the past with did, including how long, how much, what time and a final preposition: Where did you go? Who did you go with?
objective.fr: Poser des questions avec un mot interrogatif au passé avec did, y compris how long, how much, what time et une préposition finale : Where did you go ? Who did you go with ?
objective.de: Wh-Fragen über die Vergangenheit mit did stellen, auch mit how long, how much, what time und einer Präposition am Ende: Where did you go? Who did you go with?

scopeBoundaries.en: Covers Wh- questions with did + subject + base form, how/what + word questions and final prepositions. Excludes subject questions (Who called?), was/were questions and other tenses.
scopeBoundaries.fr: Couvre les questions avec mot interrogatif + did + sujet + forme de base, les questions en how/what + mot et les prépositions finales. Exclut les questions sur le sujet (Who called ?), was/were et les autres temps.
scopeBoundaries.de: Behandelt Wh-Fragen mit did + Subjekt + Grundform, Fragen mit how/what + Wort und Präpositionen am Satzende. Ausgeschlossen sind Subjektfragen (Who called?), was/were-Fragen und andere Zeiten.

prerequisites.en: Past simple statements with regular and common irregular verbs
prerequisites.fr: Les phrases affirmatives au past simple avec des verbes réguliers et irréguliers courants
prerequisites.de: Aussagesätze im Past Simple mit regelmäßigen und gängigen unregelmäßigen Verben

summary.en: Past question order: question word + did + subject + verb.
summary.fr: Ordre de la question au passé : mot interrogatif + did + sujet + verbe.
summary.de: Wortstellung der Frage in der Vergangenheit: Fragewort + did + Subjekt + Verb.

summary.en: After did the main verb is in the base form, not the past form.
summary.fr: Après did, le verbe principal est à la forme de base, pas au passé.
summary.de: Nach did steht das Hauptverb in der Grundform, nicht in der Vergangenheitsform.

summary.en: Use how long, how much, how many and what time before did to ask for detail.
summary.fr: Utiliser how long, how much, how many et what time avant did pour demander des précisions.
summary.de: how long, how much, how many und what time stehen vor did, um nach Einzelheiten zu fragen.

summary.en: Put the preposition at the end of the question: Who did you go with?
summary.fr: Placer la préposition à la fin de la question : Who did you go with ?
summary.de: Die Präposition steht am Ende der Frage: Who did you go with?

title.fr: Mot interrogatif + did + forme de base

explanationPlan.en: Show the order question word + did + subject + base form. Explain that did carries the past, so the verb stays in the base form. Give where, when, why, what, who and how.
explanationPlan.fr: Montrer l'ordre mot interrogatif + did + sujet + forme de base. Expliquer que did porte le passé, donc le verbe reste à la forme de base. Donner where, when, why, what, who et how.
explanationPlan.de: Die Reihenfolge Fragewort + did + Subjekt + Grundform zeigen. Erklären, dass did die Vergangenheit trägt und das Verb in der Grundform bleibt. where, when, why, what, who und how nennen.

examples.text: Where did you go on holiday?

translation.de: Wo bist du im Urlaub hingefahren?

pitfalls.en: Do not put the past form after did: Where did you go?, not Where did you went?
pitfalls.fr: Ne mettez pas le passé après did : Where did you go ?, pas Where did you went ?
pitfalls.de: Setze nach did keine Vergangenheitsform: Where did you go?, nicht Where did you went?

pitfalls.en: Do not use the statement order: Where did you go?, not Where you went?
pitfalls.fr: N'utilisez pas l'ordre de la phrase affirmative : Where did you go ?, pas Where you went ?
pitfalls.de: Verwende nicht die Aussagesatz-Reihenfolge: Where did you go?, nicht Where you went?

title.en: How long, how much, what time and prepositions
title.fr: How long, how much, what time et prépositions
title.de: How long, how much, what time und Präpositionen

explanationPlan.en: Teach how long, how much, how many and what time before did. Then show that the preposition stays at the end of the question: Who did you go with? What did you talk about?
explanationPlan.fr: Enseigner how long, how much, how many et what time avant did. Montrer ensuite que la préposition reste à la fin de la question : Who did you go with ? What did you talk about ?
explanationPlan.de: how long, how much, how many und what time vor did vermitteln. Dann zeigen, dass die Präposition am Satzende bleibt: Who did you go with? What did you talk about?

examples.text: What time did you get up?

translation.de: Um wie viel Uhr bist du aufgestanden?

examples.text: How many photos did you take?

translation.de: Wie viele Fotos hast du gemacht?

pitfalls.en: Use how much with uncountable nouns and how many with plural nouns: how much money, how many photos.
pitfalls.fr: Utilisez how much avec les noms non dénombrables et how many avec les pluriels : how much money, how many photos.
pitfalls.de: Verwende how much mit nicht zählbaren Nomen und how many mit Plural: how much money, how many photos.

pitfalls.en: Keep the preposition with its verb and move it to the end: Who did you talk to?
pitfalls.fr: Gardez la préposition avec son verbe et placez-la à la fin : Who did you talk to ?
pitfalls.de: Behalte die Präposition beim Verb und stelle sie ans Ende: Who did you talk to?
